description: Na₃PO₂S₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one S and three O atoms to form distorted NaSO₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent PS₂O₂ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaSO₃ trigonal pyramids. The Na-S bond length is 2.86 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.01 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.34 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent S and two O atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.02 Å. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and one longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond length. P is bonded to two S and two O atoms to form distorted PS₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaSO₃ trigonal pyramids. There is one shorter (2.07 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) P-S bond length. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and one longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to five Na and one P atom to form distorted SNa₅P octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅P octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₃P tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent SNa₅P octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃P tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and one P atom. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form ONa₃P tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SNa₅P octahedra and  an edgeedge with one SNa₅P octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-76°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom.
